summary: Phase 26 Communication (parent-notification send flows + templates + delivery webhook + secure-link) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 live tests pass against public URL covering templates list (4 seeded globals + variables whitelist), WhatsApp dry-run (recipient_count=2, skipped_count=1, quota preview), real WhatsApp send (ok=true, sent=2, skipped=1, quota decrements by 2), WhatsApp free-text blocked (400 'template'), SMS free-text allowed, Twilio webhook status transition + idempotency, audiences endpoint with student_count, principal out-of-scope 403, teacher 403, DL tamper → 410, platform templates CRUD + pending-blocks-WA-allows-SMS. Prior pytest suite (test_phase26comm.py) 9/9 continues to pass. Frontend: LPGS admin ComposeDialog flow works — Send message opens dialog, WhatsApp channel + Announcement template auto-selected, Grade 8 checkbox selectable via compose-class-{id}, review → confirm shows 'Send to 2 parent(s) via WHATSAPP?' + preview, Send now triggers toast 'Sent to 2 parent(s) · 1 skipped (no phone)' and history table updates with new DELIVERED rows + quota decrements (16→14 WhatsApp used shown live). Exam detail → overflow → Notify parents opens ComposeDialog with compose-locked-target showing 'Parents of Grade 10, Grade 8, Grade 9, Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 4' and Exam Alert template prefilled. Platform console /platform/communication shows comm-templates-card with 4 global approved templates, each with template-status-{id} selector, and the new-template-{name,body,create} fields.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed — no delete endpoint exists. Test cleanup leaked 2 TEST_LivePhase26 rows (both set to pending). Can be cleaned via DB or a future DELETE route.

issues: Grade 8 checkbox is below the visible fold on 1920x1080 since classes are rendered alphabetically starting Grade 1,10,11,12,2,3,4,5… — users must scroll inside the dialog or sort numerically for ergonomic access

action_items: (optional) Add DELETE /api/platform/comm/templates/{id} or an archive status so test/stale templates can be cleaned without DB access.
(optional) Numeric-natural sort for class list in ComposeDialog (Grade 1,2,3…10,11 instead of 1,10,11,12,2…).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7956 lines — recommend breaking Phase 25/26 comm block into /app/backend/routers/comm.py (single-file policy will become harder to maintain).
WhatsApp template approval check is correctly enforced server-side (status != 'approved' → 400) — good defence; UI should also disable WA channel for non-approved template to prevent avoidable 400s.
Twilio webhook is idempotent via equal-status short-circuit; however missing explicit transition validation (e.g., can regress delivered→sent). Acceptable for stub mode.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (admin compose, exam notify, platform templates)

seed_data_creation: Sent ~10 stub WhatsApp + SMS messages to Grade 8 parents during live testing (TEST MODE, no real delivery). WhatsApp used counter: 16/600; SMS used: 8/500. Two leaked global templates 'TEST_LivePhase26' (pending) remain in DB — no delete endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 26 fully validated. Note: /api/comm/send payload shape requires body.target = {class_ids|division_ids|class_names|all}, NOT top-level class_ids. Platform template create requires 'category' field from COMM_TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES = (announcement, exam, homework, fee, attendance, general). Platform login uses same /api/auth/login endpoint (cookie-based). Message_id in send response is under results[].message_id, not top-level message_ids.
